One P2 finding in [entity_details.rs:134](/Users/jamie/development/exposed-transitive-alias-groups-20261012/exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details.rs:134): grouped profile aliases omit member canonical names unless duplicated in `funder_aliases`.

The new test fixture demonstrates the scenario: `Bridge Funder` and `Distant Funder` join the component through other aliases, but neither canonical name appears in the returned aliases or link evidence. Searches for either name return `Exact Funder`, whose profile then lacks that searched name. The loader currently duplicates canonical names into aliases, but legacy rows and valid database records need not do so.

Union member `funders.funder_name` values with `funder_aliases` before sorting and deduplicating. Add assertions for both names to the existing connected funding test.

No other concrete correctness findings. Connected components, direct link evidence, aggregation without entry deduplication, and SQLx macro usage look consistent. Read-only review; no tests executed.
